result.title: ChemE-as-Code: An Open-Source Platform for Agentic AI in Chemical Engineering
result.comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables; Supporting Information (28 pages) appended. Submitted to AIChE Journal. Code and data: https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code
result.summary: ChemE-as-Code provides an open-source environment in which AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) can carry out chemical engineering work and engineers can check it. Its calculation tools range from catalysis through process simulation to plant layout, HAZOP and life cycle assessment, and skills tell a general-purpose agent how to use them. Engineering files are linked, machine-readable and versioned in Git; calculations run outside the LLM, each value records its origin, and automated checks report inconsistencies and out-of-date results by file and line. In an illustrative ammonia case, agents developed a written task into a preliminary basic-engineering package (simulation files, P&IDs, layout, HAZOP, datasheets, relief) for USD 224 of API cost in the design sessions. Planted faults and engineering changes show that the checks find what their rules cover and miss the rest, so they guide human review rather than replace it. No independent engineer has reviewed the design.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建了一个开源化学工程 agent 平台，让 LLM agent 调用催化、流程模拟、HAZOP、生命周期评估等工具，并在 Git 中版本化管理工程文件、为每个数值记录来源，用规则化检查报告不一致与过期结果，并以氨案例说明其与人工审查的分工。
AI.relevance_reason: 内容是化学工程工作流的工具编排与工程文件管理，不涉及视觉细节表示、latent 推理状态或 VLM 训练与决策；其数值溯源与规则检查属工程合规校验，未见可供 LVR 核查的具体方法线索。
